name: Halberd Scaffolding
description: Scaffolding hire and erection firm in the fictional city of Kingsmere.

items.title: Published worker death prosecution
items.content: Halberd pleaded guilty on 2026-02-24 after scaffolder Liam Corrigan fell 11 metres in 2024 without a harness; the court fined the firm $480,000. Court record HSF-CRT-0224.

items.title: Hire rates
items.content: A standard house scaffold costs $1,340 for 6 weeks, then $95 per extra week. Rates HSF-RT-6.

items.title: Yard loading times
items.content: Lorries load at the Kingsmere yard from 05:35; the yard foreman, Gareth Pugh, signs out tube counts on sheet HSF-YD-535.

items.title: Harness inspection rules
items.content: Harnesses are inspected every 3 months and retired after 5 years; tags are colour-coded yellow for the current quarter. Rules HSF-HRN-3.

items.title: Contract with Kingsmere Cathedral
items.content: Halberd will scaffold the cathedral tower for $1.17M over 64 weeks starting 2027-03-22; it is the firm's largest job ever. Contract HSF-CTH-0322-K.

items.title: Insurance premium hike
items.content: After the prosecution our insurer, Bastion Underwriting, will raise the premium from $142,000 to $317,000 from 2027-01-01. Letter HSF-INS-0101-B.
